name: will_o'_wisp
lore: Will-o'-wisps are malevolent spirits that haunt swamps and marshes, luring travelers to their doom with their ethereal glow. These spectral lights dance just out of reach, beckoning lost souls deeper into treacherous terrain, where they become hopelessly mired in the muck. Legends whisper they are the souls of wicked beings, cursed to forever wander the lands they once defiled, their only solace found in the suffering of the living.
